finalText:
**Build passes now.** Exit 0, `44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors`.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to match.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Simplified to `return flags.backoffEnabled === true`.

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise from the bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc), not blocking.

Next: nothing.
